page.title: OneDrive (Personal) Backup Destinations
page.subtitle: Back up containers to your personal OneDrive. The plugin handles Test, Upload, Download, Delete, and List at backup time. Large backups use Microsoft's chunked upload session so there is no size cap.
page.registerHint: Add a destination from the host's Storage Locations page and pick "OneDrive (Personal)" as the type.

fields.refreshToken: Refresh token (delivered by the OAuth consent flow)

help.clientId: Register an app at https://entra.microsoft.com → App registrations. The app must have Files.ReadWrite delegated permission and the redirect URI configured to your McHarbor instance.
help.clientSecret: Generate a client secret in the Azure AD app registration. It is encrypted at rest by the host's AES-256-GCM service.
help.refreshToken: After saving the destination, click "Save and connect" to complete the Microsoft consent flow and store a long-lived refresh token.
help.tenant: Use "consumers" for personal accounts. Use OneDrive for Business or SharePoint Online for work / school accounts.

error.noClientId: Azure AD application (client) ID is required.
error.noClientSecret: Azure AD client secret is required.
error.noRefreshToken: Refresh token is required. Run "Save and connect" first.

driveId.label: Drive ID
driveId.help: Optional. Leave blank to use the default drive returned by the provider.

basePath.label: Base Path
basePath.help: Optional. Graph path inside the drive, e.g. /Backups/2026. Leave blank to use the drive root.

clientId.label: Client ID
clientId.help: Optional. Leave blank to use the plugin-embedded default. Fill in your own Application (client) ID from the Entra admin center if you registered a custom Azure AD app for OneDrive Personal.

clientSecret.label: Client Secret
clientSecret.help: Optional. Leave blank if your app registration is a Mobile and desktop applications public client (the recommended path for Personal Microsoft accounts). Fill in only for Web registrations.

intro.tail: scopes. McHarbor stores the returned refresh token encrypted and never shows it again.

steps.save: Save this location. The plugin ships an embedded app registration so no fields are required. Optionally fill in your own Client ID if you registered a custom Azure AD app for OneDrive Personal, and Drive ID / Base Path if you want to pin a specific drive folder.
steps.signIn: Click Sign in with Microsoft (or Connect on the storage card). You will be redirected to login.live.com — sign in with the personal Microsoft (live.com / hotmail.com / outlook.com) account that owns the OneDrive you want to back up to.
steps.grant: Grant the requested Files.ReadWrite, User.Read, and offline_access scopes. McHarbor stores the returned refresh token encrypted and never shows it again.
steps.test: Click Test connection to round-trip a probe object in the chosen drive.
